newer_changes_search: Web search (PIB, MoWCD, general) for 2025-2026 PMMVY / Mission Shakti changes: no Union Cabinet decision found continuing Mission Shakti for the 16th Finance Commission period (2026-27 onward), and no revision of amounts or criteria found. A Ministry of Finance instruction (seen via another scheme's official page) extended ongoing schemes ending 31.03.2026 on the same terms up to 30.09.2026 or until 16th-FC approval. The PMMVY portal snapshot (2026-10-25) is live, still offers the 2021-22 to 2025-26 Mission Shakti guideline, and shows enrolment/payment counters. Latest PIB material found is an Aug 2025 factsheet with the same Rs 5,000 / Rs 6,000 amounts.

findings.note: The guideline covers 2021-22 to 2025-26 and the general interim extension found runs to 30.09.2026; no official document confirming the post-2025-26 scheme period was found. Not a blocker: the portal is live and still serves this guideline as current, the maternity benefit is a statutory entitlement under NFSA 2013 s.4, and nothing indicates discontinuation or changed amounts.
findings.suggestion: Add the 16th-FC continuation order or a 2026 MoWCD/PIB statement when available; keep reverify_days at 90.

findings.note: Logic matches items i-v, vii, viii of the guideline list (SC/ST, >=40% disability, BPL card, PM-JAY, e-Shram, job card, net family income < Rs 8 lakh with strict '<'). Items vi (PM-KISAN women farmers), ix (AWW/AWH/ASHA) and x cannot be checked, so 'uncertain' is correct and the rule text says so. is_bpl also counts Antyodaya cards, which is a reasonable reading of 'BPL ration card'.
'The benefit is available to a woman for the first two living children provided the second child is a girl' is not encoded (no field); content explains first child / second girl child.
